options.name: directives
options.description: List of plan directives Each directive is a dict with keys group, cpu_p1, parallel_degree_limit_p1, active_sess_pool_p1, max_idle_time, max_idle_blocker_time, max_iops, max_mbps Per-directive C(max_iops) and C(max_mbps) override the module-level options below

options.name: max_iops
options.description: Default max I/O operations per second per session for each plan directive when creating the plan (O(state=present)) Ignored unless O(directives) is non-empty; each directive can set its own C(max_iops)

options.name: max_mbps
options.description: Default max megabytes per second per session for each plan directive when creating the plan (O(state=present)) Ignored unless O(directives) is non-empty; each directive can set its own C(max_mbps)

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state of the resource plan
